body_lead: VISAKHAPATNAM: The State government has approved the allotment of 91.38 acres at Kanamam village in Anandapuram mandal of Visakhapatnam district for the development of a logistics and light industrial park to support the warehousing and storage requirements of Google’s proposed India AI Hub in Visakhapatnam. The land has been allotted to Ecobox Industrial Asset IV Private Limited at Rs 55 lakh per acre. The project envisages an investment of Rs 1,008 crore and is expected to generate around 5,000 jobs.
